response_text: In Laval, Quebec (2021–2022), about 29% of adults 18 and over were obese based on self-reported height and weight, roughly 39% of youth aged 12 to 17 were overweight or obese (a less reliable figure, to be used with caution), 16.5% of people 15 and over had arthritis, and 8.7% had diabetes. Each estimate comes with a margin of error — for example, the adult obesity rate could reasonably fall anywhere between 25.3% and 32.8%.
